projects.name: psutil
projects.description: Cross-platform lib for process and system monitoring in Python. One of top 100 most-downloaded PyPI packages with 300M+ downloads/month. Used by TensorFlow, PyTorch, Home Assistant, Ansible, Apache Airflow, Sentry, and 760K+ GitHub repos.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Code contributions, bug fixes, cross-platform testing (especially BSD/Solaris/AIX). Also documentation improvements and PR reviews.
projects.funding: GitHub Sponsors page with tiered sponsorship (logo/name placement in README for sponsors). No explicit goal stated.
projects.howToContribute: Open PRs on https://github.com/giampaolo/psutil. Also sponsor via GitHub Sponsors or Patreon.

projects.name: Compiler Explorer (Godbolt)
projects.description: Interactive compiler exploration website - see how C++, Rust, Go, D, Haskell, Swift, Python and 30+ languages compile to assembly in real time. Handles 3M+ compilations per week at godbolt.org.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Code contributions (TypeScript/Node.js), adding new compilers/languages, new features, bug fixes, documentation. Also financial support for server costs.
projects.funding: Patreon, GitHub Sponsors, PayPal, and Compiler Explorer merch store. Server costs are significant due to high traffic.
projects.howToContribute: Read CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ folder for adding compilers/languages. Contact via GitHub issues. Also sponsor financially.

projects.name: refine
projects.description: React meta-framework for building internal tools, admin panels, dashboards & B2B apps. Headless architecture with 15+ backend connectors. Has AI agent for project generation.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Contributors for the framework. The sponsor page mentions 'Contributor' tier suggesting code/test/docs contributions are welcome. Goal is $10K/month (currently at 1%).
projects.funding: $10,000/month goal on GitHub Sponsors. Currently 1% funded.
projects.howToContribute: Open source contributions to refine framework. Check their GitHub for good first issues.

projects.name: fl_chart
projects.description: Highly customizable Flutter chart library (Line, Bar, Pie, Scatter, Radar charts). Active YouTube channel with Flutter tutorials.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Documentation improvements, new chart types (see open 'New Chart Request' issues), more samples, fixing important issues, improving the live web app at app.flchart.dev (needs Windows/Linux/Mac/Android/iOS support).
projects.funding: GitHub Sponsors - any support frees up maintainer's time for the project.
projects.howToContribute: Work on open issues at https://github.com/imaNNeo/fl_chart/issues, particularly sorted by reactions. Documentation contributions also needed.

projects.name: Keebio
projects.description: Mechanical keyboard designer specializing in split keyboards. QMK Firmware collaborator, maintains QMK Toolbox, KiCAD footprints library, keyboard case designs, and Plate Generator web tool.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Help maintain QMK firmware PRs, work on keyboard PCB design tools, open-source PCB designs. More time for cool keyboard designs and repository maintenance.
projects.funding: GitHub Sponsors - sponsorships allow more time for open source work and design projects.
projects.howToContribute: Contribute to QMK firmware, work on keyboard-related open source repos, or sponsor financially.

projects.name: Django Girls
projects.description: Global non-profit empowering women to organize free programming workshops. Volunteer-run with hundreds of contributors. Remote-friendly post-pandemic.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Volunteers, workshop organizers, mentors. Funding for Awesomeness Ambassador, workshop materials, participant learning resources, and anti-racist systems/processes.
projects.funding: GitHub Sponsors - funds staff, materials, and merchandise subsidies for developing countries.
projects.howToContribute: Volunteer at djangogirls.org, organize workshops, contribute to materials, or sponsor financially.

projects.name: Zen Browser
projects.description: Minimalist, distraction-free web browser built for privacy and user-first experience. Ad-free, independent.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Financial contributions to cover server costs, ongoing development, and community support. Maintainers need funding to stay independent.
projects.funding: Donations via GitHub Sponsors. Every contribution helps keep them ad-free and independent.
projects.howToContribute: Sponsor financially or contribute to the browser's open source development.

projects.name: qgis2web
projects.description: QGIS to web map conversion plugin. Essential tool for GIS professionals publishing maps online.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Code contributions, bug fixes, and funding. Maintainer explicitly says 'your payment will be dedicated entirely to the development of the software.' Also available via opengis.it.
projects.funding: GitHub Sponsors or alternative payment page at opengis.it/buy-me-a-coffee/.
projects.howToContribute: Sponsor financially or contribute code via GitHub. Alternative: opengis.it/buy-me-a-coffee/.

projects.name: nutti (Magic UV, fake-bpy-module)
projects.description: Indie developer creating Blender add-ons and Unreal Engine extensions. Magic UV merged into Blender itself. fake-bpy-module essential for add-on development. Screencast Keys popular among tutorial creators.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Feedback and user testing. Sponsorships allow more time for developing useful software.
projects.funding: GitHub Sponsors - feedback via sponsors helps maintainer engage more.
projects.howToContribute: Use the add-ons, provide feedback via GitHub, sponsor financially.

projects.name: Githooks
projects.description: Per-repo and shared Git hooks with version control and auto-update. Nix evangelist working on Rust/Go/C++ projects.
projects.whatTheyNeed: Contributors and sponsors. Goal: 20 monthly sponsors (currently 2). Sponsorship enables more features and contributions across projects.
projects.funding: GitHub Sponsors goal: 20 monthly sponsors (currently 10%). Logo/name in project README for sponsors.
projects.howToContribute: Contribute to Githooks or other projects. Sponsor to reach 20 sponsor goal.

notes: GitHub Sponsors explore page shows ~25 featured sponsors.
The 'seeking contributors' / 'looking for maintainers' labels are not explicitly displayed on the explore page - these labels appear in individual sponsor profiles.
Most projects have explicit funding goals or sponsorship tiers on GitHub Sponsors.
Browser automation (Playwright) was blocked by existing Chrome instance; used web_fetch as fallback.
Several sponsors are not accepting contributions (require login to view or no specific contributor info).
